# Error #53: ClaimNonceReplay

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#53`
- **Variant Name**: `ClaimNonceReplay`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `ERROR`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::ClaimNonceReplay` — the claim's nonce was already spent for this pair.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/sponsor_test.rs::replayed_nonce_is_rejected_and_cannot_double_spend`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/sponsor_test.rs::replayed_nonce_is_rejected_and_cannot_double_spend). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// ClaimNonceReplay — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let sponsor = Address::generate(&f.env);
register_sponsor(&f, &sponsor, 10_000, 10_000);
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
f.advance_time(2 * DAY);
enroll(&f, &f.recipient);
// Seed the nonce directly (a real spend would need valid sigs),
// then the replay check fires before signature verification.
f.env.as_contract(&f.client.address, || {
    sponsor::mark_nonce(&f.env, &sponsor, &f.recipient, 5);
});
Some(rejected!(sponsored_claim(&f, &sponsor, id, 1, 5, {
    f.env.ledger().timestamp() + DAY
})))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked replayed_nonce_is_rejected_and_cannot_double_spend
```

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Use a nonce that has never been spent for this `(sponsor, beneficiary)` pair; a successful claim consumes the nonce permanently.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#13-gas-sponsorship-relayed-claims-without-a-mempool-relayer`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#13-gas-sponsorship-relayed-claims-without-a-mempool-relayer)
